summary: Implemented split_amount in ledger/split.py as integer-cent even split with leftover cents to earliest entries, refund negation per convention 4, and ValueError/TypeError validation; added tests. Full suite passes (11 passed; baseline was 1 failed).
assumptions: Non-int or bool total/parties raises TypeError, since floats are forbidden for money.
Negative totals are split by applying the rule to the absolute value and negating every share, per CONVENTIONS.md item 4.
